assign.request: Press every demo under /imagine/paging/ except make/ headless at 400/1280/1920/3440, fix each finding inside the fence, mark superseded premises, rebuild the hub as one screen of picture cards, and write editor-notes.md for the editor rethink.
assign.now: scoping - reading the hub, the readme and the child pages
steps: Scope: read hub, readme, list demos
Start private server on 8106, write the probe
Press the hub + every child at 4 widths
Mark superseded demos, delete dead ones
Rebuild the hub as picture cards

assign.now: pressed 39 pages at 4 widths - numbering the findings

log.msg: Pressed all 39 pages (hub + 38 children; make/ excluded by fence) at 400/1280/1920/3440 on :8106. Clean on the mechanical checks: 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors, 0 404s, 0 horizontal overflow at any width, 0 localStorage keys written by any demo. So nothing is broken - what is wrong is what a stranger sees.

Finding 1 (hub, level 1). The first 150px of /imagine/paging/ at 1920 is the seven-dropdown toolbar, then a live page. The six building blocks the realm is organized around appear only as rail text and as one markdown line 3100px down. A stranger cannot say in ten seconds what paging IS.

Finding 2. Three pages open with pixel-identical first screens: the hub, /stage/ and /mechanisms/swap/ all run navigation:tabs content:cards room:wide arrangement:plain surface:card background:tint type:regular. Clicking Stage in the rail appears to change nothing.

Finding 3 (the owner's own complaint). Every page that puts a stage on screen shows all SEVEN dropdowns - eight on the twelve library pages - when the page is about exactly one of them. /room/ says 'change the room dropdown' above a bar of seven. Counted: 7 selects + Code + More = 9 controls on 25 pages, 10 on library.

Finding 4. The same generic caption sits between the demo and the page's own sentence on 20+ pages: 'Click a page name, or change a word in the bar above. This line will say what changed.' Identical everywhere, so it carries no information, and each page's real lede then says the specific version of it.
Finding 5. The colour value swatch is white-on-white with no border: on /skin/ 'CONTENT COLOUR [_] Card' reads as an empty, unset box. Two of the nine controls look broken at rest.

Finding 6. /imagine/paging/build/ is a whole directory (page.js + doc/) whose entire content is 'The builder moved into Make.' - 69 words, no demo. The realm already answers moved names with a one-line route() row in page.js.
Finding 7. /mechanisms/, the index of the four mechanisms, opens on a static article page with none of the four visible on the first screen; the four live miniatures start 1000px down.
Finding 8. /navigation/doc/ is titled 'Docs' and holds one card. The realm already has a page titled 'Docs' at /imagine/paging/doc/ - two pages, one title, one realm.

Finding 9 (premise superseded). templates/families.js recommends '/framework/core/Page/overview/columns/finder/ - Miller columns, built out of nothing new' as a member of the columns family. Continuous Miller columns are not the direction as of 2026-09-17.
Skipped the usage.json refresh: ai/usage.json is outside this task's write fence (paging/** plus the task dir).

assign.now: fixing - toolbar focus, the hub rebuild, the three moves

log.msg: Fix 3 shipped. A page may now declare bar_axes - the axis names its bar shows - and toolbar.js shows()/hidden() filter the groups; the More button counts what is behind it ("6 more words"). block.js derives it for every block page and every value page, so /room/ is ONE dropdown, /skin/ is three, /stage/ is none (its own heading already says it owns no word), the four mechanism pages and /navigation/ are one each. The hub, library and templates keep all seven. Nothing is deleted: More opens the same drawer with every word in it.

Fix 1+2 shipped - the hub is one screen. It opens on SIX live picture cards, one per building block, each configured so that block's own word is the visible thing: Navigation has a left rail, Content a dashboard, Room the narrow box, Arrangement a toolbar, Skin the dark surface. Then one sentence, which is the way in (Make a page). Cards before 16 (12 presets + 4 gestures, 0 for the blocks); cards after 6, all blocks. The twelve preset shots MOVED to /library/, replacing its twelve text cards; the four gesture miniatures MOVED to /mechanisms/, which is the page about them. The playable stage stays, one heading down.

Measured while building the hub: the shot frame is 366px and room:narrow caps at 384px, so the Room card could not show its own word - it drew a box filling its frame like every other card. Room's card is two columns wide now (.paging-shot-wide), the narrow box stops at 384px in a ~750px frame, and the gutter is the lesson.

And the trap that came with it: span 2 does NOT clamp on a one-column grid - it FORCES a second track. At 400 the wall read 266px + 120.938px, the Room card came out 401px in a 344px wall and the realm's middle scrolled sideways (429 against a 400 client). Behind a container query on the wall now (min-width 40em); re-measured at 400: one 344px track, midScroll 400 = midClient 400, no overflow at any of the four widths.

Fix 4 shipped. The stage caption at rest said 'Click a page name, or change a word in the bar above. This line will say what changed.' on 20-odd pages, 20px above each page's own sentence saying the same thing with the actual word in it. It now says only what it alone knows: 'This line measures the box after every change.' The page's lede keeps the instruction.

Fix 6 shipped (deleted). build/page.js is gone and `build` is a row in the hub's MOVED map, so /imagine/paging/build/ still answers with one sentence and a link. Counted the inbound links first: one live link (make/readme.md, outside my fence and still working), the rest are prose mentions in comments and doc/builder.md. The DIRECTORY stays - words.js, draw.js and build.css are live code that make/, config.js and stage.js import; build/readme.md now says so on its first line.

Fix 7 shipped. /mechanisms/ opened on an article-shaped stage - the same first screen as five other pages - with its four mechanisms 1000px down as TEXT cards, while the four live clickable miniatures sat on the hub, where the reader had not met the word yet. The miniatures moved here and are the first thing on the page.

Finding 5 left, with a reason: the colour swatch has been through two prior passes (self-evident-critique-2 finding 8, -3 finding 2). It carries a hairline at --fill-a32, a different edge per surface (card keeps the outer shadow, tint goes dashed) and a hover title naming the value. A white swatch that looks white is the honest picture of `card`; and with bar_axes the two swatches are now only on Skin's own pages.

Fix 8 shipped. /imagine/paging/navigation/doc/ was titled 'Docs' - so was /imagine/paging/doc/, in the same rail. It is 'Measurements' now. The DIRECTORY keeps its name because six live links point at navigation/doc/measurements/.

Finding 9 marked superseded, not rebuilt. /imagine/paging/templates/columns/ teaches elastic shares of a row and five width words, which is what core does but no longer what to reach for. One line at the top now: 'Superseded 2026-09-17 by even columns' with the measured alternative (/imagine/design/navigation/). Paging.supersedes() is the seam, .paging-superseded is the marker, and Template.content() draws it above the demo. The finder's row in templates/families.js keeps its link and says what it is: the continuous row, the model even columns replaced.

Finding 10, found by driving it and fixed. On all twelve template FAMILY pages the CONTENT dropdown did nothing at all: the family draws the box itself through the stage's `draw:` seam. Measured on /templates/columns/ at 1280 - switching content Article -> Card wall left the stage's text byte-identical, while navigation, room, arrangement and the three skin words all changed it. A dropdown with no consequence reads as broken, and it was in the bar of all twelve. Template now carries bar_axes = the three skin words, which is exactly what its own sentence promises.

And the trap that came with THAT: bar_axes had to go in Template.initialize(), not a class field. A class field initializes after super() returns, and Page's constructor runs assign -> naming -> declare -> initialize inside that super() - so the field would silently overwrite a bar_axes a page passed in. The `classes = "x"` trap from the code skill, in its other direction.

Re-pressed all 39 urls at 400/1280/1920/3440 after the fixes: 156 rows, 0 flagged - no console errors, no 404s, no horizontal overflow, no localStorage. /imagine/paging/build/ still answers (it is a MOVED route now, not a page.js).

Finding 2 finished properly. /stage/ and /mechanisms/swap/ ran byte-identical configurations (tabs over a card wall), so the two pages opened on a pixel-identical picture. /stage/ opens on stacked sections now - a visibly different box, still a content kind that uses the width it is given, which is the reason the card wall was chosen in the first place. Its sentence says 'watch where the box stops' rather than 'watch its white box', because one of the bands is dark.

One more console 404 found and closed: /imagine/paging/readme/ rendered through core's last-resort Page.file() fallback, which only runs AFTER Page.load() misses - so every visit logged 404 /imagine/paging/readme/page.js, on the url the hub's own closing line points at. Six lines of route() in the hub; the page now has a real title and a clean console.

Persistence proven by driving it, not by reading the code: on /room/ set room=wide, the url became ?room=wide and the stage painted paging-room-wide; reloading the BARE url came back paging-room-reading, the page's own word, with zero localStorage keys. A demo does not persist.

Final sweep: 43 urls (38 dirs with a page.js under the hub, plus the /build/ and /readme/ routes, plus /imagine/, /imagine/codrops/ and /imagine/paging/make/ as regression) at 400/1280/1920/3440 = 172 rows, 0 flagged. No console errors, no 404s, no horizontal overflow, nothing persisted, on any page at any width.

Documented: readme.md (the opening now describes the six pictures; bar_axes in Use; two new traps in Watch out), doc/decisions.md (a 2026-09-17 section - bar_axes, the hub, the caption, the build deletion, the superseded rule, the two small ones), doc/page.js (five records, not four), build/readme.md (the directory is code now, not a page).

assign.outcome:
**Pressed 38, fixed 11, superseded 1, deleted 1, left 1.** Every page under `/imagine/paging/` except `make/` was driven headless at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440. Nothing was broken — no errors, no 404s, no overflow, nothing persisted — so the work was what a stranger sees.

**The bar now shows the page's own word.** A page says `bar_axes` and `toolbar.js` filters the groups; `More` counts what is behind it. [Room](/imagine/paging/room/) is ONE dropdown over a live page (it was nine controls, and its own sentence said *change the room dropdown*). [Stage](/imagine/paging/stage/) has none at all — its own heading already said it owns no word. The twelve family pages lost a `content` dropdown that was measured doing literally nothing.

**The hub is one screen.** Six live pictures, one per building block, then the sentence that is the way in. Cards: 16 before (twelve presets, four gestures, none for the blocks) → 6 after, all blocks. Nothing was deleted: the twelve preset miniatures moved to [Library](/imagine/paging/library/), the four gesture miniatures moved to [Mechanisms](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/) — both pages are about exactly those things and both were opening on something else.

![before](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/paging-fix/hub-before.png)
![after](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/paging-fix/hub-after.png)

**Superseded, not rebuilt:** [templates/columns](/imagine/paging/templates/columns/) carries one line at the top pointing at [the even-columns study](/imagine/design/navigation/). **Deleted:** `build/page.js` — a whole page whose only job was to say the builder moved; the url is a row in the hub's `MOVED` table now and still answers.

**Left:** the colour swatch, twice-iterated already — a white swatch that looks white is the honest picture of `card`, and it now appears only on Skin's own pages.

The notes for the editor rethink: [editor-notes.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/paging-fix/editor-notes.md) — Panel already cut its bar from fifteen icons to four and put the rest in a right rail driven by one selection event; that is the shape, and Make has the panes.
